fusions.name: Flushed from Cover
fusions.desc: Sends a burst of locusts into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage. Your movement speed rises 12% for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Startled Rising
fusions.desc: The swarm takes off through a wide cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 13 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Bounding Away
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 8% for 6 seconds, and carries you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Bolting Instinct
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
